description: This file defines a comprehensive TalkModeManager class responsible for handling speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, and chat interactions within an iOS app. It manages microphone permissions, audio session configuration, speech recognition tasks, TTS output (via ElevenLabs and fallback to system voice), and communication with a chat gateway. It also includes functionality for push-to-talk, incremental speech streaming, and handling various states of speech processing.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for holding error state related to stream failures.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Main class managing voice interaction modes including speech recognition, text-to-speech, and chat communication, integrating with OpenClaw services.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Attaches a GatewayNodeSession for chat communication

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates connection status to gateway and triggers recognition start if connected

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the chat session key and manages chat subscriptions

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TalkMode, starting or stopping speech recognition accordingly

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts speech recognition and related processes if enabled and configured

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all speech recognition, TTS, and chat activities, releasing resources

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone usage without fully disabling TalkMode

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Resumes recognition after returning from background if previously suspended

methods.name: userTappedOrb

methods.name: beginPushToTalk

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition session

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError
methods.description: Attempts to restart recognition after transient errors

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech recognition

methods.name: makeAudioTapAppendCallback

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Processes partial or final speech transcription results

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring for silence to trigger automatic processing

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence threshold has been reached to finalize speech processing

methods.name: schedulePTTTimeout
methods.description: Schedules automatic termination of push-to-talk after a timeout

methods.name: handlePTTTimeout
methods.description: Handles push-to-talk timeout expiration

methods.name: finishPTTOnce
methods.description: Resumes continuation after push-to-talk completes

methods.name: processTranscript

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded

methods.name: buildPrompt

methods.name: stopSpeaking

methods.name: shouldInterrupt

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterruptForCurrentRoute

methods.name: shouldUseIncrementalTTS

methods.name: applyDirective

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetch

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
